witness_rule: An interval closes only when a pinned object's .text ends exactly at the interval end: its code is a run of catalogued functions ending at the interval start, every non-relocation bit of that code equals the original, its section size is the code end rounded up to the section alignment (16 or 32), and the rounding bytes are zero with no symbol or relocation in them. A composite interval may append minimal linker fill before an object witnessed by another record, or one all-zero original object. Zero content, geometry or entrylessness alone never qualify. Padding is never C/C++ credit.

tiers.canonical_reproduction: object emitted by the pinned toolchain from the predecessor's canonical source under its canonical profile; exact matcher receipt text_bytes == slot_bytes, 0 differing words
tiers.alternate_profile_reproduction: object emitted by a declared pinned profile other than the unit's canonical one (gcc272-kmc26-O2-signed, which rounds .text to 16); exact matcher receipt text_bytes == slot_bytes, 0 differing words; requires Main/Sol policy admission
tiers.original_sdk_object: unmodified member of the pinned public SDK repack (n64sdk.7z sha256 9e3969af...) whose .text maps onto the original
tiers.witness_assembler_reproduction: canonical compiler output assembled by the witness-only gas 2.9.1 variant (same pinned tarball, fp32 patch and host patches; --target=mips-mips-rtems, so only TARGET_OS differs from the pinned mips-mips-elf build). Gate: all 5816 matched gnu291-fp32 units assemble to byte-identical .text code, relocations and symbols. Provenance is a diagnostic matcher receipt (never adoptable) where the matcher admits one; for the three pinned libgcc units it is the accepted build's compiled .s. v3 adds the binutils-2.37 witness variant (mips64-rtems, same tarball and configure as the pinned mips64-elf build; bit-exact control rebuild; 190/190 modern237 units gated) for the five modern237 predecessors.
tiers.witness_assembler_joint_reproduction: the same variant assembling one TU span: the accepted build's compiled .s of each canonical unit from the nearest 16-aligned catalogued function start up to the predecessor, concatenated with only per-unit local-label renaming. The pinned-gas control object of the same span reproduces the original code (0 non-relocation differences, exact size). There is no matcher receipt, because the matcher compiles one C/C++ candidate.
tiers.witness_assembler_cross_profile_joint: one-assembler-run object of a 16-aligned TU span whose canonical units mix compiler recipes or languages (gcc281pm/gcc272, C/C++). The units' compiled .s come from the accepted build or exact matcher runs, with only per-unit local-label renaming. The pinned-assembler control reproduces every non-relocation bit of the span. This shows rounding of exactly these bytes, not historical TU identity.

ingress_scan.method: Every 4-byte-aligned big-endian word in ROM [0x1000,0x148460) (all four CPU images, text and data) compared with the VRAM of every word inside the 598 ranges (per-image VRAM mapping; overlays share VRAM so any overlay alias is included); every lui followed within 8 words by addiu/ori on the same register composed and compared.
ingress_scan.limits: Computed addresses other than lui+addiu/ori, runtime-built pointers, compressed-asset contents and DMA-loaded data outside the CPU images are not covered; this is supplementary to the retained direct J/JAL/branch scan, not global reachability proof.

qualifications: The preceding original word at ROM 0x5D74 is jal 0x80027FA0 (delay slot 0x5D78); its architectural return address 0x8002A97C lies in this range. Classification rests on the original exceptasm.o section geometry (code ends at 0x5D7C, .text sh_size rounds to 0x5D80, tail zero, no relocation or symbol in it), not on a non-return proof; the retained boundary-details.json cleanup/dispatch evidence is cited, not re-proved.

The 16-byte remainder is linker alignment fill: the following original object mtxcatf.o (pinned SDK member, raw-equal at 0x7FC0, its own tail classified by record cpu_gap_000080b0_000080c0) has .text sh_addralign 32, and 0x7FB0 is the 16-rounded end of the reproduced motor TU.
